BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY INC.

Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements, Continued

### (13) Subsequent Event

On April 3, 1969, Berkshire Hathaway Inc. acquired 81,989 shares, out of a total of 100,000 shares outstanding, of the common stock of the Illinois National Bank and Trust Co. of Rockford, Illinois, at a cash price of $190.00 per share. They also have made a tender offer to acquire the remaining outstanding shares at the same cash price.
